newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Minotaur varies Gawler joint venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Minotaur varies Gawler joint venture.

text.p: Minotaur Gold NL, a junior explorer in South Australia's Gawler Craton region, said on Wednesday it had varied its joint venture agreement in the search for platinum group minerals (PGM) at Commonwealth Hill.
Minotaur said this followed the recording of anomalous platinum up to 17 parts per billion (ppb) drilled by the Mines and Energy South Australia searching for iron ore.

To investigate the possible presence of economic PGM, Minotaur said it had agreed that Gawler Gold and Mineral Exploration NL, formerly Lakes Gold Pty Ltd, may raise its interest in a designated portion of EL1900 in relation to PGM

Minotaur said present interests are Minotaur 70 percent, Gawler Gold 30 percent, but Gawler Gold could increase its stake in the Wirrida tenement during the first 12 month option period to 51 percent by spending A$500,000.
It may in the second option period of 12 months increase its interest to 65 percent by spending A$1 million, it said.

Minotaur said that if, during the exploration for PGM, Gawler Gold discovered other minerals, Minotaur could retain its 70 percent interest by paying an amount equal to 210 percent of the directly attributable expenditure.
In its quarterly report, Minotaur said rotary air blast drilling at its Birthday anomaly in the Gawler Craton had outlined four sub parallel zones with gold mineralisation.
"One metre samples in weathered rock returned 1.2, 0.5, 0.7 and 1.1 grams per tonne gold from each respective zone," it said.
